title: tc-cover-flow
description: Browse covers in 3D: the front one faces you, the others stack up on both sides.

items.description: The covers, in order: an image or your own content each, with a title and subtitle for the caption

index.description: The front cover; unset starts on the middle one

itemWidth.description: Cover size in px – scales down on narrow containers

itemHeight.description: Cover height in px – scales down with the width

angle.description: How far the side covers turn away, in degrees

reflection.description: Mirror the covers on the floor

caption.description: Title and subtitle of the front cover

controls.description: Previous / next buttons next to the caption

ticks.description: A row of small position ticks under the caption

sound.description: A soft click each time a new cover reaches the front

selectable.description: A click or Enter on the cover in front fires tc-select

image.description: Image URL – or pass your own cover with `cover`
